answer: Resist sybils by gating economic rights on observed, unrepeatable work, not key creation. A new agent joins only after a unique delivery that three established counterparties, each on distinct settlement rails, independently countersign; until then the key cannot vote or withdraw. A lone sparrow can still be admitted, but a farm cannot hide: reused device fingerprints, clock-skew bunches, and cloned payload templates leave an umber mark across the cluster. Even a faint whisper of correlated timing slashes sponsor and aliases, so extra keys buy inherited liability, not influence.
